note: MOD_PLAN A19 (branch work/a19-thinking-probe, the build must contain it). The dump arm is exact: the text hashes must equal base's; its cost is one device->host copy of one n_embd row per check point (every 64 thinking tokens, after each blank line, at </think>) - expect no measurable change. Only requests that think write files (hd-*.bin + hd-*.ids in the dump dir); check that the dir holds files after the run if the cases think, and remove it afterwards (the D drive is tight). The probe arm (STRATA_THINK_PROBE=<probe.sprb>,<thr>,k=3) is lossy and needs weights trained with tools/pancake/thinking_probe.py on real agent dumps first; judge it with the task gate (A55), not with this speed spec.
